caso.texto:
A fictional dataset has 20 opportunities: eight won, four lost and eight still open. Of 30 activities, five duplicate existing records. Two opportunities end before their start date. A blank budget was converted to zero without confirmation.

An Indian CRM team receives branch exports with repeated account names and IST timestamps. Shared names do not establish duplicates. INR values mix monthly service and one-time project amounts, requiring explicit type fields.

projeto.instrucoes: Create a minimum data dictionary, flag inconsistencies, calculate explicit-denominator rates and propose a routine preventing recurrence.
projeto.gabarito: Win rate among closed=8/12=66.67%; wins among all=8/20=40%, answering different questions. Open cases are not losses. Verify duplicates, correct dates from sources and restore unknown budgets rather than invent values.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
